parts.title: Art Day
parts.text: Gabi, Noel, and Fatou loved art class. Today they would help paint a big **mural** for the hallway. First, each child set up an **easel** and picked up a **paintbrush**. Gabi squeezed bright colors onto her **palette**.

parts.title: Mixing Colors
parts.text: Noel wanted a lighter blue, so he mixed in some white paint. It made the blue a soft **tint**. He used the tip of his brush to **dab** tiny dots of yellow on the sky. Then his elbow bumped the paper and made a **smudge**. “Oops!” he said. The table was getting **messy**, but Fatou only laughed. “Art can be like that,” she said.

parts.title: Clay and Paper
parts.text: Next, the teacher handed out clay. Fatou tried to **sculpt** a little bird. Gabi pressed her clay into a **mold** shaped like a star. Noel glued bits of colored paper onto a card to make a **collage**. He felt very **creative**.

parts.title: Show Time
parts.text: At the end of class, the children set their work on a long table. Parents and friends came to look. Everyone had made something different, and every piece was special. Gabi smiled. Art could look any way you wanted it to look.
